name: Respondent
description_en:
Respondent helps research teams find and manage people for studies. Its core workflow runs from audience targeting and screening through scheduling, research and incentive payment. It covers consumer and professional recruitment and supports moderated, unmoderated and AI-moderated work. A researcher looking for people who use a particular business tool is therefore solving a different problem here from merely creating a questionnaire.

The platform now also describes an AI moderator, recordings and synthesis within its participant-based offer. These do not remove the need for a clear research method or qualified audience. Costs separate recruitment from participant incentives, and researcher accounts differ from the participant accounts used to apply for paid studies.
description_zh:
Respondent 帮助研究团队寻找并管理研究参与者。核心流程从受众定位与筛选开始，延伸到预约、开展研究和支付奖励，覆盖消费者及专业人士招募，以及有人主持、无人主持和 AI 主持的研究。希望找到某种业务工具的真实使用者，与单纯创建一份问卷，是两类不同需求。

平台目前也在按参与者收费的方案中介绍 AI 主持、录制和内容综合，但这些能力不能代替明确的研究方法或合格的受众。成本需要把招募费与参与者奖励分开计算；用于开展研究的账户，也不同于申请有偿研究的参与者账户。

core_features.explanation_en: Target roles or behaviors and qualify applicants with a custom screener.
core_features.explanation_zh: 根据角色或行为定位人群，再用自定义筛选问卷判断申请者是否符合条件。

core_features.explanation_en: Connect Google or Outlook and set availability, notice, buffers and daily caps.
core_features.explanation_zh: 连接 Google 或 Outlook，设置可约时间、提前通知、缓冲和每日上限。

core_features.explanation_en: Fund incentives separately from recruitment; the service describes payouts through Tremendous.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在招募费之外单独准备奖励资金；服务说明通过 Tremendous 发放。

en: Recruit business-software users for a moderated concept interview.
Screen and schedule consumers for a usability study.
zh: 为有人主持的概念访谈招募业务软件用户。
为可用性研究筛选并预约消费者。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Define the target audience, research method and screening questions before publishing a recruit.
steps.zh: 发布招募前定义受众、研究方式和筛选问题。

steps.en: Connect the moderator calendar, set booking rules and preview participant-visible slots.
steps.zh: 连接主持人的日历，设置预约规则，预览参与者可见的时段。

steps.en: Budget recruitment and incentives separately; verify completion and payment handling on a small study.
steps.zh: 分别预算招募费与奖励，并通过小型研究核对完成及支付处理。

items.en: Vendor verification and matching claims do not establish that every recruited person meets your study criteria.
items.zh: 厂商对验证和匹配的说明，不能证明每位被招募者都满足本次研究条件。

items.en: API access requires setup with the vendor, and incentive costs are additional.
items.zh: API 接入需要与厂商配置，奖励费用另计。

pricing.billing_basis: USD recruitment fee per completed session; consumer/B2B and methodology rates vary. Incentives funded separately.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: The retrieved PAYG view lists $40 per consumer session and $80 per B2B session. Recruitment only: participant incentives are extra. Annual commitments start at $7,500 and lower rates by tier; API access is arranged with sales. The page says failed screeners, no-shows and mid-interview dropouts are not charged, subject to confirming the applicable study terms.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 本次读取的随用随付视图列出消费者每场 $40、B2B 每场 $80，仅为招募费，参与者奖励另付。年度承诺从 $7,500 起，不同档位降低单场费率；API 接入需洽谈。页面说明未通过筛选、未出席及访谈中途退出不收费，仍需核对适用研究条款。

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Start with the people your question requires
sections.title_zh: 先明确研究问题需要哪些人
sections.en:
Respondent lets researchers specify demographics, roles, skills and product-use criteria, then use custom screeners, including skip logic, to qualify applicants. The recruitment page describes identity and professional checks, but those are vendor process descriptions rather than independent proof of every participant’s suitability.

For an illustrative study of a project-management product, define actual use frequency and decision responsibilities instead of recruiting anyone with a broad job title. Review screener answers before accepting people, and keep eligibility separate from the desired answer to your research question. A matched panel is not automatically a representative sample of the whole market.
sections.zh:
Respondent 允许研究者指定人口属性、角色、技能和产品使用条件，并用带跳题逻辑的自定义问卷筛选申请者。招募页说明了身份与职业检查，但这是厂商流程说明，不是对每位参与者适用性的独立证明。

例如研究项目管理产品时，应定义真实使用频率和决策职责，而不是招募所有具有宽泛职称的人。接受申请前核对筛选答案，把参加资格与希望得到的研究结论分开。匹配到的人群也不自动代表整个市场。

sections.title_en: Make availability part of the study setup
sections.title_zh: 把可约时间纳入研究配置
sections.en:
Scheduling connects to Google or Outlook and supports project windows, notice, buffers and maximum daily sessions. Teams can identify a moderator and required or optional attendees; the service describes generated meeting links, reminders and rescheduling. Manual and automatic scheduling are separate choices.

Before launch, preview exactly which slots a participant can book. For a study across time zones, our suggested check is one test booking with the intended moderator and stakeholders, including a reschedule. No calendar or meeting-link execution was tested for this profile.
sections.zh:
预约功能可连接 Google 或 Outlook，设置项目日期、提前通知、缓冲和每日场次上限。团队可以指定主持人、必须参加者及可选参加者；服务说明包含会议链接生成、提醒和改约，并可选择手动或自动预约。

发布前先预览参与者实际能选择的时段。跨时区研究建议用预期主持人和观察者做一次预约及改约检查。本文没有实际执行日历或会议链接测试。

sections.title_en: Recruitment and research execution are connected but distinct
sections.title_zh: 招募与研究执行相连，但职责不同
sections.en:
The platform describes a target–screen–schedule–research–pay workflow and connections to external research tools. It also offers an AI moderator, recordings and synthesis within the current pricing description. Choosing AI moderation changes how questions and follow-ups are delivered; it does not establish that the output is an accurate research finding.

Shortlist Respondent when access to qualified people and coordination is the bottleneck. If you already have a usable customer list and only need a simple survey link, first compare that narrower requirement. This is an editorial fit judgment, not a tested price or quality comparison.
sections.zh:
平台说明了定位、筛选、预约、研究和支付的连贯流程，也可连接外部研究工具。现行价格说明还包含 AI 主持、录制和综合分析。选择 AI 主持会改变提问与追问方式，但不能据此证明输出就是准确的研究发现。

当合适的受访者来源与协调工作是主要瓶颈时，Respondent 值得列入候选。若已有可用客户名单、只需简单问卷链接，应先比较这一较窄需求。这是编辑选型判断，未进行价格或质量对比实测。

sections.title_en: Budget a session and its incentive separately
sections.title_zh: 把单场招募费与奖励分开预算
sections.en:
The public PAYG pricing view shows USD $40 for a consumer session and $80 for a B2B session, with methodology and commitment selectors. Incentives are explicitly excluded. For a hypothetical ten-session B2B study at the displayed $80 list rate, recruitment would be $800 before incentives, taxes or any different agreed terms. That is arithmetic, not a quote.

Annual commitments begin at $7,500 and can reduce per-session rates; the service says only completed sessions are billed and lists screener failures, no-shows and mid-interview dropouts as uncharged. Confirm how completion, cancellations, replacement requests and unused commitment are treated in the agreement. API access must be arranged with the vendor.
sections.zh:
公开随用随付视图展示美元计价，消费者每场 $40、B2B 每场 $80，并有研究方式和承诺档位选择。参与者奖励明确不包含在内。假设十场 B2B 研究适用页面 $80 标价，招募费即 $800，尚未含奖励、税费或其他约定条件。这是算例，不是报价。

年度承诺从 $7,500 起，可以降低单场费率。服务说明仅对完成场次收费，列明筛选失败、未出席及访谈中途退出不收费。协议中仍需确认完成定义、取消、替换请求和未用承诺额的处理。API 接入需要与厂商安排。

sections.title_en: Keep a researcher responsible for exceptions
sections.title_zh: 为研究异常保留明确负责人
sections.en:
The site describes managed support and participant verification, but a project still needs someone to review questionable fit, missing attendance and incentive status. Do not interpret advertised fill times or low fraud percentages as an SLA or an independently measured outcome. This research did not recruit anyone or exercise a dispute.

Respondent is presented as a hosted service; no deployable server package or open-source license was established. Participant-facing earning opportunities and researcher-facing purchases have different purposes and terms. Contractual data retention, recording consent, geography for a particular niche and export behavior remain due-diligence questions for the intended study.
sections.zh:
官网说明托管支持与参与者验证，但研究项目仍需要有人核对可疑匹配、缺席及奖励状态。不能把宣传的填满时间或低欺诈比例当作 SLA 或独立测量结果。本文未实际招募人员或处理争议。

Respondent 作为托管服务呈现，本次未确认可部署服务包或开源许可。参与者赚取奖励与研究者购买招募服务的目的和条款不同。具体研究的合同数据保留、录制同意、细分人群地区覆盖及导出方式，仍需另行核查。

research_gaps: No participants recruited, sessions booked, payouts made or AI moderation outputs tested.
Current contract definitions for completed sessions, cancellation, replacements and unused annual commitment were not verified.
Study-specific audience availability, consent, retention, data export, storage location, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
